title: REQ · Old RoundBadge and Countdown usage is removed from App
summary: App no longer imports or renders RoundBadge or a standalone Countdown.
description: Context: App.tsx renders RoundBadge and Countdown directly at the top of the scene. Desired behavior: delete those imports and JSX, since HeaderOverlay shows status and countdown. Expected result: only one countdown (inside the header) exists. Why: avoid duplicated round UI.
acceptance_criteria: Given a resolved round, when the playing view renders, then exactly one timer element exists (inside the header)
Given the playing view, then no element from RoundBadge renders outside the header
Given App.tsx source, then it does not import RoundBadge or Countdown

in_scope: Removing imports and JSX from App.tsx
